name: combobox
title: Auro Combobox
description: Typed, accessible editable combobox with list autocomplete. Logic lives in the framework-free @auro/headless core; the React render layer is copied into your repo and yours to edit. Built on the same shared primitives as Select.

a11y.ariaAutocomplete: list — the input filters the options; focus stays in the input
a11y.ariaActivedescendant: input tracks the highlighted option; focus never leaves the input
keyboard: Typing filters the list and reseeds the highlight to the first match
ArrowDown/ArrowUp open the listbox and move the highlight (skipping disabled options)
Home/End jump to first/last enabled option
Enter commits the highlighted option and closes
Escape closes the listbox, keeping the current value

props.name: options
props.type: Array<{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }>

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder shown in the empty input.

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Fired with the selected option's value when the user commits a selection (empty string on clear).

auro.docs: Import { Combobox } and pass `options`. Control it via `value` + `onValueChange`, or use `defaultValue` for uncontrolled usage. The input filters options by label as the user types. Set `placeholder` for the empty state and `disabled` to inactivate the control.
